caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed centrally within the image. The pitcher has a bulbous body that narrows toward the top, a wide spout, and a handle on the right side. The surface of the pitcher is primarily a creamy beige color with numerous blue blotches and streaks distributed unevenly over its surface, creating a marbled effect. The handle has a slightly organic, twisted appearance, and the spout is broad and curves outward. There are two rectangular raised reliefs on the body of the pitcher, one more prominent on the front, featuring an indistinct motif. The background is plain and beige, with a faintly outlined rectangular border encasing the drawing, giving the pitcher full visual emphasis. No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
